title: adrenaline shot: dosing intensity
content:
artifacts are metaphorical-poetic teachings for navigating the creative life, released as a part of labyrinth library.

you can listen to an excerpt below ~

explore this artifact

did I mention that I’m an adrenaline junkie? I thrive with deadlines, I procrastinate until the very last minute, I’ll generate chaos just to have friction to push against — because I crave the feeling of peak aliveness. something happens to me in the hours before a deadline. a beast-version of me wakes up, and takes over, and brings me through turmoil into a state of effortless creative flow.

but, for a long time, I felt shame and guilt around my own propensity for thrill-seeking. was there something wrong with me? was I addicted to stress, to the detriment of my own wellbeing?

for this artifact, I did a lot of research around the biochemistry of how adrenaline actually works in the brain — and why it’s effective for creating the conditions for creative activation. I reframed thrill-seeking into a desire for challenge, clarity, and sharpened sense of focus.

this might be one of my favorite artifacts of season 2 — I’m excited to share it with you.

*

purpose — to embrace the desire for intensity as something to design for deliberately — working with a creative metabolism that needs the pressure of extreme focus and release, in generative, sustainable cycles.

guiding question — how do we use the biochemistry of activation to create containers for peak creative aliveness?

astrological season: aries

trail-marker word: aliveness
